summary: D028 is a cleaner source explanation than D027 but a weaker poem than preserved D010. Its lineation parcels a definition into short units, its closure repeats the source conceit, and its strongest pressure already appears with more image, motion, and resistance in D010. The honest revision is to stop the successor lineage, not draft D029.

Reversing presentation does not change the result: D010 contains more irreducible lines and less documentary dependence.

revision_instruction: Do not revise D028 into D029. Preserve D028 as the terminal traceable head, return operational attention to D010, and seek one disclosure-first non-identifying reader response before any new poem-generation work.
